releaseNotes: v1.0.0 — standalone version baseline. panrouter-go now numbers itself independently of upstream PanRouter: 1.0.0 is the first release on that scheme, and each release publishes two artifacts — an immutable vX.Y.Z tag plus a rolling `latest` pointer (GitHub releases/latest, the version.json manifest on main, and the docker :latest tag) that `panrouter-go update` follows. Installs still on 1.9.x are not offered 1.0.0 automatically, because the updater reads 1.0.0 as older; reinstall once from the release assets. See docs/RELEASING.md.
